summary: Example AnsibleAutomationPlatform CR (aap.ansible.com/v1alpha1) for the growth topology with eda.automation_server_ssl_verify 'no' and hub storage_type 's3' using object_storage_s3_secret.
questions: Show an example AnsibleAutomationPlatform custom resource
How do I configure S3 storage for automation hub in the AAP CR?
How do I disable SSL verification from EDA to controller in the CR?

answer_card.title: AnsibleAutomationPlatform CR with S3 hub storage
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
apiVersion: aap.ansible.com/v1alpha1
kind: AnsibleAutomationPlatform
metadata:
  name: <aap instance name>
spec:
  eda:
    automation_server_ssl_verify: 'no'
  hub:
    storage_type: 's3'
    object_storage_s3_secret: '<Secret holding the S3 configuration>'
```
